non_vacuity.pass_condition: every injected row is assigned its frozen expected_class, AND at least min_criteria_flagged distinct defect criteria (INVERTED, OFF-DOMAIN, BOILERPLATE-ONLY, FRAGMENT, UNBACKED) are exercised, AND the injected rows are excluded from the population support rate and the verdict.
non_vacuity.purpose: tests the HARNESS, not the population. It does NOT satisfy the minimum-population requirement.

normalization.anchor_match_rule: ANCHORS match with prefix tolerance: two stemmed tokens match when they share a prefix of >= min_anchor_prefix_chars characters, or when a multi-token anchor occurs as a contiguous subsequence. Prefix tolerance IS used for anchors because German compounds ('fuer_sorgepflicht' inside 'fuer_sorgepflichtverletzung') must match, and because the anchor is the question's own vocabulary.
normalization.marker_match_rule: MARKERS match EXACTLY on stemmed tokens: a single-token marker must equal an evidence token after stemming; a multi-token marker must occur as a contiguous subsequence of stemmed evidence tokens. Prefix matching is NOT allowed for markers, because it would let 'limita' license a sentence that only says 'procedimento limitato'.
normalization.sentence_split: the product's own evidence string is already the cited sentence(s); it is split on ';' into segments only for per-segment marker reporting

stemming.note: Applied to both anchors and evidence tokens. Anchor matches when an anchor token and an evidence token share a prefix of >=5 characters after stemming (prefix matching, not equality, so 'fuer_sorgepflicht' matches 'fuer_sorgepflichtverletzung').

normalization.umlaut_digraphs: ue->u, oe->o, ae->a after folding (Swiss legal spelling)

primary.definition: The three accepted gate-packet bundles named in the charter (results/product/gate_packet/38799024807/questions/*.bundle.json). The charter states the accepted-chain labelled population is exactly 7 candidate-limiting rows plus 7 'cited' placeholders.
primary.population_drift_policy: If the bundles' actual labelled rows differ from expected_rows, the harness records the drift in the report as population_drift and scores what is actually present. This file is NOT re-frozen.

secondary.definition: Pre-declared replication over EVERY other accepted live bundle on the mount that issues counter statuses. Declared because the charter asserts the gate-packet bundles are the ONLY accepted-chain material issuing counter statuses; that assertion is falsified by the mount (7 further accepted live bundles issue 39 further counter labels). Scoring them under the identical frozen rubric is a replication, not a scope change: the verdict is still decided on primary.

reporting.determinism: Identical inputs must produce a byte-identical report. The report embeds rules_sha256 and the sha256 of every input. No wall-clock, no randomness, no dict-order dependence: all iteration is over sorted keys / sorted row lists.

required_distributions.counter_markers_precision: markers reported by the artifact vs markers actually present in the cited evidence string. At accepted head the counter_markers field is ABSENT on every counter row; the harness therefore reports markers_reported (from the field when present, else the row's counter_reason), markers_in_cited_evidence and, where full_text exists, markers_in_row_text as the document-wide union proxy for the audit's scope finding.
required_distributions.language_distribution_of_counter_rows: count of scored rows per row.language, per bundle and overall (covers the D1 finding that no Italian vocabulary is ever probed)
required_distributions.rank_distribution: ranks of every scored row, plus the count of SUPPORTED rows outside the conventional top-20 (the pre-registered gate's route to a positive q1/q3)
required_distributions.uncertainty_distribution: counter_uncertainty per scored row, and the subset of unsupported rows whose uncertainty is the LOWEST in their bundle
required_distributions.verbatim_check: whether counter_evidence occurs verbatim in the row's own full_text (reproducibility of the citation)

assignment_precedence.when: cited evidence string is empty or absent
cited evidence matches a frozen fragment_pointer pattern
a frozen procedural_formula matches the cited evidence AND no counter-intent marker occurs in it
a frozen polarity_inversion pattern matches the cited evidence
no PIVOT anchor in cited evidence, title or regeste; or language outside expected_languages; or legal_area foreign
no counter-intent marker in the cited evidence
no DOMAIN anchor in the cited evidence or the row title/regeste

rubric.cited_evidence_string: At accepted head the bundle row carries no sentence pointer or offset and no counter_markers field, so the row's OWN counter_evidence string IS the cited evidence. Where full_text is present the harness additionally records whether the cited evidence occurs verbatim in the row's own text.

criteria.i_intent_marker_in_cited_evidence: At least one frozen counter-intent marker occurs in the CITED EVIDENCE STRING ITSELF (the row's own counter_evidence), matched on the normalised stemmed tokens. Document-wide presence does not count.
criteria.ii_no_polarity_inversion: No frozen polarity-inversion construction occurs in the cited evidence (challenge failed / challenged ruling stood / role-blind negation).
criteria.iii_not_procedural_boilerplate_only: The cited evidence is not exclusively a procedural-disposal or procedural-admission construction: either no frozen procedural construction matches, or the matched construction carries a procedural OUTCOME word, or a counter-intent marker also occurs in it.
criteria.iv_topical_term_in_evidence_or_title: A frozen DOMAIN-tier anchor of the row's own question occurs in the cited evidence string or in the row title/regeste. Without it the correct product verdict is counter_status='none'.
criteria.v_not_demonstrably_outside_question_doma: A frozen PIVOT-tier anchor of the row's own question occurs in the cited evidence string, the row title or the row regeste (the decision's own abstract); AND the row's language is in the question's expected_languages; AND the row's legal_area field is not in the question's foreign_legal_area_fields.

defect_classes.BOILERPLATE-ONLY: The cited evidence is a procedural-disposal or procedural-admission construction with no counter-intent marker: form, not substance.
defect_classes.FRAGMENT: The cited evidence is a bare pointer or placeholder with no proposition ('cited in generated answer', 'darüber genaue Angaben BGE ... S.', an ellipsis, a bare statute or case reference).
defect_classes.INVERTED: The cited evidence affirmatively inverts the polarity of the label: a frozen polarity-inversion construction occurs in the cited evidence itself.
defect_classes.OFF-DOMAIN: No frozen PIVOT-tier anchor of the row's own question occurs anywhere in the row's own text (cited evidence, title, regeste), or the row's language is outside the question's expected languages, or its legal_area field is listed as foreign. The row is a real decision in the right language that does not speak to the question.
defect_classes.UNBACKED: None of INVERTED/OFF-DOMAIN/BOILERPLATE-ONLY/FRAGMENT applies, but the label is still unsupported because criterion (i), (iv) or (v) fails. Reason codes are reported: evidence_absent, no_intent_marker, no_domain_anchor.

rubric.multi_label_reporting: Every criterion outcome is reported per row (criterion_marks: i..v pass/fail with the matched lexicon item), so the primary class is auditable and a reader can recompute any other precedence without re-running the harness.
rubric.precedence_rationale: Ordering follows the charter's own criterion order (iii before ii is required so a pure admission formula is not double-counted as inverted) and its defect-class enumeration. Absence of cited evidence outranks every substantive class because a label with no evidence cannot be assessed for polarity, topic or domain.
rubric.reported_separately_never_scored_reason: counter_status='cited' carries the accepted contract's NON_QUOTE_REF placeholder 'cited in generated answer' (evidence.py:40) and asserts NO limiting/contrary polarity, so it is not a counter label. It is counted and its placeholder share reported, never scored as a label.

sensitivity_variants.change: criterion (v) is relaxed to a legal-area/language check only; the PIVOT-anchor test is dropped.
sensitivity_variants.why: Criterion (v) is the only criterion whose operationalisation required an authored interpretation (the question's distinguishing subject matter). The Master Prompt non-negotiable is per-label, so one weak criterion cannot be allowed to decide a verdict silently. This variant bounds the verdict.

sensitivity_variants.change: the product's own ADVERSARIAL_TERMS (including the bare negations 'nicht'/'jedoch'/'toutefois'/'tuttavia') are dropped from the counter-intent vocabulary; only the frozen additions count.
sensitivity_variants.why: The audit attributes a share of the defect to a bare-substring marker vocabulary. This variant measures how much of the result depends on reusing that vocabulary.

verdict_rule.INSUFFICIENT_POPULATION: n_scored < required_min_population_primary, or any of the frozen primary rows could not be scored from the accepted evidence fields. This is a NON-RESULT: it must not be read as LABEL_SOUND nor as a pass of any product fix.
verdict_rule.LABEL_SOUND: primary population: n_scored == required_min_population_primary AND n_supported == n_scored (support_rate == 1.0, i.e. every issued label is supported by its own cited evidence under criteria i-v).
verdict_rule.LABEL_UNSOUND: primary population: n_scored == required_min_population_primary AND n_supported < n_scored (support_rate < 1.0). ANY single unsupported issued label makes the label set unsound, because the Master Prompt non-negotiable is per-label and is absolute, not averaged.
verdict_rule.aggregation: no averaging, no weighting, no per-language or per-bundle exemption
verdict_rule.replication_reporting: The secondary population is reported with its own rate and verdict under the same frozen rubric. It is a REPLICATION, never a substitute: the charter's verdict is decided on the primary population. If the two disagree, both are reported and the verdict names the primary.
